title: STARK Benchmark: Multi-Domain Evaluation for GraphRAG Systems
summary: The STARK benchmark is a specialized dataset designed to evaluate Large Language Model (LLM) retrieval capabilities on semi-structured knowledge bases. It serves as a comprehensive test for GraphRAG systems by covering three distinct application domains: product search, academic paper search, and precision medicine. This multi-domain approach allows for a holistic assessment of current GraphRAG performance across diverse query types.
key_findings: STARK is classified as a benchmark specifically designed for GraphRAG systems, distinct from general downstream task datasets.
The benchmark tests LLM retrieval performance on semi-structured knowledge bases rather than purely unstructured text.
One of the covered domains is Product Search, evaluating the system's ability to handle commercial query tasks.
Academic Paper Search is included as a domain to test retrieval capabilities in scholarly contexts.
Precision Medicine is a key domain, focusing on the system's capacity to handle complex medical queries.
The benchmark aims to access the overall capacity of current GraphRAG systems by providing a comprehensive test result across these three areas.
